title: Got a free usage reset for Opus 5.5 (expires Oct 22). Is it worth saving for a big gamedev session?
author: SushiMasterPro
selftext:
This "Resets" card just appeared for me.

According to Anthropic help center, a reset puts your 5-hour session limit or weekly limit back to full immediately. They say it is given "occasionally to eligible plans", and unused resets expire. You can see the expiration date under Settings > Usage.

They don't really explain who is eligible, so I am curious:

* Did you get one? Which plan are you on?
* Did anyone get more than one?
* Are you saving it for something bigger, or just using it when you hit the limit?
* What would you use it for?

I am thinking to save mine for something big, like a large refactor or a content push with quests/item data, instead of spending it immediately. Probably it will be longer weekend for me

replies.author: Big_Presentation2786
replies.body:
We shouldn't even be talking about it!

I've said too much.
